thesis: CPI 8:30 ET (cons 0.6% m/m headline, 0.2% core), BAC/MS/BLK earnings pre-open, Barkin 12:30, Beige Book 14:00. Prior day (Oct 13) SPY O 777.34 H 778.75 L 775.95 C 778.01 (exa.ai). Use 30-min OR 9:30-10:00. LONG if a 5-min candle closes above OR high, above VWAP, AND above 778.75 (prior high). SHORT if it closes below OR low, below VWAP, AND below 775.95 (prior low). Stop = opposite OR side (or OR mid if tighter). Target 2R. No entry 12:15-12:45 (Barkin) or after 11:30. Skip if OR width is outside 0.2-1.0% (~$1.56-$7.78). Invalidation: close back inside the OR, VWAP lost, or 2 failed breaks. Shares = min(floor(100/|entry-stop|), floor(10000/entry)); at ~$778 the cap is 12 shares, so risk will be under $100.
